title: Two decision records cannot share a number or an id: pr-render and doctor flag it, nugit's own store is tested for it, and the task-words record moves to ADR-0063
acceptance_criteria: the task-words record is ADR-0063 in its file name, id, heading and every citation that means it, and every ADR-0055 left means the governed-config record; a PR that adds or modifies a decision sharing its file number with another decision of the same id namespace in the same directory fails pr-render, and so does one that adds a decision whose number the target branch's tip already holds; nugit doctor reports the whole store's shared numbers beside its shared ids; a test over nugit's own .nugit store fails on a store with two ADR-0055 records and passes after the renumber
